public_rationale: SoftBank's investor briefing of November 11, 2025 says it 'completed sale of all shares held' in Nvidia in October 2025, for about $5.8 billion. A footnote says this covers sales by both SoftBank Group and SB Northstar. Tom's Hardware also reports that SoftBank sold its entire stake: 32.1 million shares for $5.83 billion. So the factual claim holds. Whether the sale is an ominous sign for generative AI is opinion and is not scored. SoftBank said it sold to fund its large OpenAI investment.
limitations: The 'ominous sign' framing is not scored.
